functional.claims: Cortex-M3 instruction execution (Thumb-2, NVIC, SCB, SysTick, DWT, semihosting) extracted from EmbCC; every register of the RM0008 description with its reset value and access type; behavioural models of RCC (HSI, HSE, PLL, bus prescalers and clock gates), GPIO (modes, ODR/BSRR/BRR, IDR from the pin's net), AFIO (EXTI routing, USART1 remap), EXTI (edges, pending, interrupts), USART (8 or 9 data bits with parity and 0.5 to 2 stop bits at the baud rate on TX and from RX, the error flags and IDLE, breaks and LIN, mute mode, nCTS/nRTS flow control and CK on their AFIO pins, half-duplex, synchronous master mode, interrupts), TIM1 to TIM4 (up, down and center-aligned counting, the repetition counter, output compare and PWM, input capture with its filter and prescaler, TIM1's MOE, OSSR and OSSI, the software break (BG) and LOCK, the slave modes and encoder mode, external clocks, TRGO between the timers) with their channels on their AFIO pins, SysTick's HCLK/8 reference and its CALIB of 9000 (RM0008), ADC1 and ADC2's regular group (software start, scan, continuous, sampling times, the ADC clock from ADCPRE, the pins' voltages, alignment, EOC and its interrupt, calibration's timing), SPI1 and SPI2 on their AFIO pins as masters or slaves (modes 0 to 3, 8 and 16 bits, MSB or LSB first, the baud prescaler, TXE, RXNE, OVR and its clearing, BSY, the receive-only and bidirectional modes with the master clocking on its own, NSS by SSM/SSI, SSOE or the pin, MODF, a slave's selection and its bit count kept across NSS, CRC with CRCNEXT and CRCERR, the interrupts), I2C1 and I2C2 as masters and slaves on their open-drain pins: START, repeated START (once the bus is free), STOP, 7-bit and 10-bit addressing (ADD10), ACK and POS, the SR1 and SR2 flags with their clearing sequences, BTF clock holding, CCR's standard and fast timing with a slave's clock stretching honoured, arbitration lost (ARLO), BUSY and BERR from the bus as the pins show it; the slave's OAR1 (7 or 10 bits), OAR2's dual address, the general call, the SMBus default, host and alert response addresses, ADDR, BTF and TXE stretching or NOSTRETCH's OVR, STOPF, the master's NACK (AF); PEC with CR1.PEC and PECERR; SMBus's TIMEOUT and SMBALERT; SWRST; the event and error interrupts, FLASH and PWR registers. Other peripherals keep their register values and raise mcu.unsupported_access on first access.
omissions: the ADC's injected group, analog watchdog, external triggers, dual mode and DMA
I2S; I2C's noise filtering, the SMBus's cumulative clock low extensions, clock synchronization between two masters
the timers' complementary outputs, break and ETR on pins (TIM1's CHxN, BKIN and ETR are not routed through AFIO), their DMA requests

timed.claims: Instruction timing is estimated from EmbCC's per-class cost table with the taken-branch refill (ADR-015), not cycle-exact; peripherals count the cycles of their bus clock exactly from the clock tree (ADR-019).

electrical.claims: GPIO pin-model defaults from the datasheet: voh/vol, rout by configured speed, vih/vil with hysteresis, 40 k pulls, 5 V tolerant pin list (SPEC-003 §2). The GPIO model applies direction, push-pull or open-drain drive and the weak pulls to the pins as the firmware configures them.
